rulesTestNames: lets managers list an event's help-request and delivery views
owner: Host event delivery view evaluator: hostReadModels event delivery view triggers
read: current organizer managers list an event's views (organizerId and eventId, ordered by document id); authority comes from the organizer document
write: server only; one view per live message, deleted when the message is missing or not live, or its organizer or event is gone
migrationNotes: view is the row the retired listEventAssistanceDeliveries callable returned, evaluated at evaluatedAt; relevantUntilMillis is when its manual handoff lapses, which the phone applies on its own clock, so no sweep runs.
sourceCoverage invalidSource keeps the previous view and names incompleteSource; the phone fails the page rather than hiding a message.
